voice.autoTranscribe.enabledInfo: The text becomes the caption of your voice message
voice.autoTranscribe.translationFailed: The transcription could not be translated, the caption was added untranslated.
voice.custom.info: Build your own voice. The same settings sound the same in voice messages, video messages and calls.
voice.custom.mixFooter: Below 100% your real voice is audible in the mix.
voice.custom.name: Name
voice.custom.pitchFooter: Timbre tilts the sound from dark to bright; it is not a formant shift. There is no tempo and no reverse: calls and video messages cannot change the length of the sound, and the voice must sound the same everywhere.
voice.custom.title: Custom voice
voice.eq.bandsFooter: Changes apply to what is already playing, without clicks.
voice.eq.bandsInfo: Move a band and the preset becomes Custom. A value is saved when you release the slider.
voice.eq.footer: Playback equalizer: videos and video messages stay on their own player. It never touches signals, the recording tone or other service sounds.
voice.menu.morphCallsInfo: Private and group calls; applied at once, even mid-call
voice.menu.morphFooter: The voice is changed at the moment of recording, so your real voice is never stored and never sent by any route: right away, after listening, from a draft, as a story reply or scheduled. The length and waveform of the message are those of the changed sound. Anonymous mode uses its own preset without touching your choice.
voice.menu.morphInfo: The voice is changed while recording
voice.playback.builtInMicrophoneInfo: Voice and video messages use the phone's microphone even with headphones
voice.playback.disableAutoplayInfo: The next voice or video message does not start by itself
voice.playback.footer: Keep music playing is the Pause Music While Recording switch from Data and Storage, shown here for convenience: it is one setting.
voice.preset.anonymousInfo: Lower and darker with a drifting pitch, hard to shift back
voice.preview.morphOff: Voice changer is off — hear it before switching on
voice.preview.phrase: Hi! This is how my voice will sound.
voice.transcription.footerApple: Without Telegram Premium, voice and video messages are transcribed by Apple's recognition: on the device when the language has a model, otherwise on Apple's server. With Premium it switches to Telegram's server by itself.
voice.transcription.footerPremium: You have Telegram Premium: voice and video messages are transcribed by Telegram's server. If Premium ends, transcription switches to Apple's recognition by itself.
voice.transcription.notAuthorized: Allow Ghostgram to use Speech Recognition in iOS Settings to transcribe voice messages.
voice.transcription.wordBubblesInfo: Tap a word to play from there
